training.split: grouped by run: separate datasets generated with disjoint seed ranges; test split untouched during training/selection
training.labelPolicy: leak: a leak has started and its open-area fraction at the window end is >= 0.05; sensor_fault: a sensor fault is active at the window end; operating_change: a public pump/valve command (t > 0) lies inside the feature window; normal: otherwise. Hidden inlet temperature / water-cut changes are labelled normal (policy: the D1 observer accounts for measured composition; composition_change is not a separate class in this version). Runs terminated by a model-domain stop are cut at the stop time.

evaluation.note: validation only; see evaluate for the held-out test split
